query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Manage Salesforce leads, contacts, campaign membership, campaign attendance statuses, a campaign-based static list, and MQL lead activity reporting.
query_ground_truth.query: include a contact in a campaign member list and set their presence status
query_ground_truth.rationale: Adding a contact to a campaign directly corresponds to managing campaign membership and attendance statuses.

request.query: include a contact in a campaign member list and set their presence status

results.use_case: include a contact in a campaign member list and set their presence status
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Collect a stable contact identifier to query using BREVO_GET_CONTACT_DETAILS (avoid ambiguous free-text).
[Required] [Step]: Retrieve the contact record using BREVO_GET_CONTACT_DETAILS (confirm the returned record matches the intended contact).
[Optional (if you need to discover available target lists)] [Next Step]: Enumerate lists using BREVO_GET_CONTACT_LISTS (use results to pick the correct destination list by name/metadata).
[Required (if direct lookup fails)] [Fallback]: Enumerate contacts using BREVO_GET_ALL_CONTACTS with offset/limit paging and filter client-side to find the matching record.
known_pitfalls: [BREVO_GET_CONTACT_DETAILS] Identifier mismatches can lead to “not found” outcomes; ensure the identifier type/format matches what the tool expects before falling back to bulk enumeration.
[BREVO_GET_ALL_CONTACTS] Requires offset/limit pagination; failing to iterate all pages can miss the target contact when filtering client-side.
[BREVO_GET_CONTACT_LISTS] Provides list discovery metadata only; it does not by itself add/update contacts or change list membership with the available toolset.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) is an all-in-one email and SMS marketing platform that provides transactional messaging, marketing automation, contact management, and CRM tools to help businesses communicate and engage with their customers.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=brevo. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="brevo") to create a connection BEFORE executing any brevo tools.

BREVO_GET_CONTACT_DETAILS.description: This tool retrieves detailed information about a specific contact in Brevo. You can identify the contact using their email address (URL-encoded), their unique contact ID, or their SMS attribute value.

identifier.description: Identifier of the contact. Can be an email (URL-encoded), contact ID, SMS, WhatsApp, landline, or external ID. Brevo infers the type of identifier automatically.

mobile_number.description: Mobile phone number (SMS attribute) of the contact to search for. Used as a fallback if the primary identifier is not found. Accepted formats: 91xxxxxxxxxx, +91xxxxxxxxxx, 0091xxxxxxxxxx, or international format like +16135551234.

BREVO_GET_CONTACT_LISTS.description: Retrieves all contact lists from your Brevo account with pagination support. Returns list IDs, names, subscriber counts, and folder associations. Use this to discover available lists or obtain list IDs needed for other operations (e.g., SMS campaigns, adding contacts to lists).

sort.description: Sort order by creation date: 'asc' (oldest first) or 'desc' (newest first).

limit.description: Number of contact lists to return per page.

offset.description: Index of the first contact list to return (for pagination).

BREVO_GET_ALL_CONTACTS.description: This tool retrieves all contacts from your Brevo account with pagination and filtering based on modification/creation dates, list IDs, segment IDs, and contact attributes. For complete retrieval, iterate pages by incrementing `offset` by `limit` on each call until no more records are returned; a single call returns at most `limit` contacts.

sort.description: Sort the results in the ascending/descending order of record creation.

offset.description: Index of the first document of the page

listIds.description: List of list IDs to filter contacts. Cannot be used together with segment_id.

segmentId.description: ID of the segment to filter contacts. Cannot be used together with list_ids.

createdSince.description: Filter contacts created after a given UTC date-time. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss+HH:MM

modifiedSince.description: Filter contacts modified after a given UTC date-time. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss+HH:MM

time_info.message:
- This is time in UTC timezone. Get timezone from user if you needed.
          - Always use this time info to construct parameters for tool calls appropriately even when the tool call requires relative times like 'last week', 'last 24 hours', 'today', 'tomorrow' etc.
          - Do not hallucinate the time or timezone by yourself.

session.instructions: REQUIRED: Pass session_id "keep" in ALL subsequent meta tool calls for this workflow.

2) Extract validated plan steps returned above, acknowledge each step, then execute sequentially updating current_step parameter. Check pitfalls during execution.
